{{Quote|The boy's a Jedi. Kill him.|Boba Fett, to the Banasthaurs and other patrons at Al the Alchemist's cantina|<ref name="Lost Jedi 18" />}}
The '''Banasthaurs''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Limb/Legends|winged]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]]<ref name="Lost Jedi 18" /> native to the [[Banasthau system/Legends|Banasthau system]], located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="Atlas" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> They were present in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Lost Jedi 18" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], several Banasthaurs visited a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]]. The cantina, known as [[Al The Alchemist's]], was patronized by [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], [[Smuggler/Legends|gun-runners]], and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] from across the galaxy, the infamous [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] among them. Also present in the cantina that [[Standard day/Legends|day]] was [[Havet Storm]], a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Youngling/Legends|boy]] whose [[Morvet Storm|grandfather]] had been a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. The patrons discovered that Storm was carrying a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], so the Banasthaurs and other bar-goers clustered around the boy, staring at him with hostile intent. Fett, who bore a grudge against the boy from a previous encounter, ordered the assorted patrons of the cantina to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Storm,<ref name="Lost Jedi 18" /> but the boy escaped.<ref name="Dark Forces">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050616a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 6: Outcasts and Megalomaniacs Welcome}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|They are standing around you in a close ring &mdash; humans, lizard-like Druulgothans, Ma'alkerrite ape-men, winged Banasthaurs &mdash; gun-runners, mercenaries, and bounty hunters from all across the galaxy. And they are all staring at you.|A mention of Banasthaurs in the front matter of ''The Lost Jedi''|<ref name="Lost Jedi 18" />}}
[[Paul Cockburn]] created the Banasthaurs for his pick-a-path adventure ''[[Jedi Dawn]]'', published by [[Boxtree]] in [[1993]]. The Banasthaurs are not mentioned in the adventure itself, only in the front matter immediately following the book's cover.<ref name="Lost Jedi 18" /> The scene described here closely matches a scene contained in the adventure, which includes the same quotation from Boba Fett. The Banasthaurs are also mentioned in the front matter of ''[[The Lost Jedi Adventure Game Book]]'', published in [[1992]], which collected ''Jedi Dawn'' and its sequel, ''[[The Bounty Hunter]]''.
